name: codex-dev-companion
description: A local LangChain development agent connected only to user-configured LiteLLM endpoints.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Local Companion reads project files and can execute explicitly approved local tools, so the workspace must be trusted.

commands.title: Local Companion: Add Selection to Context
Local Companion: Add File to Context

enumDescriptions: Focused LangChain createAgent runtime with explicit local tools and bounded context.
Advanced createDeepAgent runtime with planning support, context compaction, workspace filesystem tools, and local subagents.
codexDevCompanion.agentRuntime.description: Agent runtime used for this workspace. Both options use the same local LiteLLM Chat Completions connection.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every workspace mutation and command.
Apply scoped file and project-memory edits automatically; commands and deletions still require approval.
Inspect and plan with read-only tools; do not mutate the workspace or run commands.
codexDevCompanion.autonomyMode.description: Default autonomy level for new Local Companion requests in this workspace.

codexDevCompanion.liteLlmEndpoint.description: HTTPS LiteLLM gateway base URL or complete Chat Completions URL.

enumDescriptions: Send the key as Authorization: Bearer, the standard LiteLLM mode.
Send the key in the api-key header used by Azure-compatible gateways.
Send the key in the default Azure API Management subscription header.
codexDevCompanion.liteLlmAuthHeader.description: HTTP header used to authenticate the Chat Completions request.

codexDevCompanion.liteLlmModel.description: Exact client-facing model alias configured by the LiteLLM gateway administrator.

codexDevCompanion.liteLlmModelsEndpoint.description: Optional HTTPS model-catalog URL queried with Cache-Control: no-cache and the stored key in the api-key header.

codexDevCompanion.liteLlmModelProfiles.description: Optional Chat Completions parameters stored per exact model alias. Missing fields are omitted from the request. Prefer the LiteLLM form in the Local Companion sidebar.

codexDevCompanion.gatewayCaCertificatePa.description: Legacy workspace-relative corporate CA PEM path. Existing values are migrated automatically to the extension's global local storage.

codexDevCompanion.autoContext.description: Include the active file, selection, diagnostics and workspace summary with each request.

codexDevCompanion.maxContextCharacters.description: Maximum number of characters collected from the editor for one request.

codexDevCompanion.maxConversationCharact.description: Maximum number of recent conversation characters retained as model context.

enumDescriptions: Notify only when the Local Companion sidebar is not visible.
Notify after every completed or failed run.
codexDevCompanion.completionNotification.description: Controls local VS Code notifications after completed or failed agent runs. Notifications never include request, response, project, path, or model content.

codexDevCompanion.semanticMemoryEnabled.description: Use the bundled local ChromaDB vector store to retrieve relevant entries from project memory. Requires an embedding model alias.

codexDevCompanion.embeddingModel.description: LiteLLM model alias used only for embeddings. Leave blank to use memory.md without semantic retrieval.

codexDevCompanion.semanticMemoryResults.description: Maximum number of semantically relevant project-memory chunks injected into a run.

codexDevCompanion.standardRecursionLimit.description: LangGraph recursion limit for the standard runtime. Deep Agent uses its own high native limit and compaction behavior.

codexDevCompanion.localBrowserToolsEnabl.description: Expose approval-gated LangChain tools for inspecting and visually checking applications on localhost. Non-loopback browser traffic is blocked.

enumDescriptions: Try the installed browser most common on this operating system, then the other supported browser.
codexDevCompanion.localBrowserChannel.description: Installed browser used for local app validation. The extension never downloads a browser.

codexDevCompanion.localBrowserExecutable.description: Optional absolute path to a corporate Chromium-based browser. Leave blank to find installed Edge or Chrome automatically.

codexDevCompanion.localBrowserOpenPrevie.description: Ask VS Code to open the same localhost URL for the user when the agent starts an isolated validation session. VS Code 1.109+ opens localhost links in the integrated browser by default.

scripts.test: npm run compile:tests && node --test dist-tests/test/**/*.test.js && npm run test:repository
scripts.test:repository: node --test test/issue-forms.test.mjs test/license-inventory.test.mjs test/native-package.test.mjs test/release-metadata.test.mjs test/security-audit.test.mjs
scripts.test:extension-host: npm run build && npm run compile:extension-host-tests && node scripts/run-extension-host-tests.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:litellm && npm run smoke:chroma
